'''Syndicalism''' is a labor-centered political tradition that influenced several Avant ideologies concerned with worker control, industrial administration, and the relationship between production and political authority.

This draft exists as an Avant bridge page. It does not attempt to reproduce a complete external history of syndicalism.

== Avant Branches ==

In Veszprem, syndicalist ideas fed into [[Orderism]] after the [[Syndicate Revolution of 1949]]. The older Orderist form emphasized worker councils, collective ownership, and local accountability.

In Vorkutangrad, old source material describes [[Gorodovaya Syndikalizm]], an urban-industrial variant that treated city infrastructure, housing, and factories as a single worker-managed system.

Later [[Unified Orderism]] kept parts of the syndicate vocabulary while subordinating councils to a stronger central state.
